name: Flamegor
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/blackwing-lair/flamegor.md. Era 40-man: 999,300 HP, no enrage, tauntable. Modelled as one 240 s phase (research: 4-5 minutes). Frenzy: first ~10 s, then every 10-15 s (cmangos; logs 8.3-11.3 s between removal and the next cast). Real Frenzy is 10 s, +150% attack speed, Fire Nova every 2 s, removed only by Hunter Tranquilizing Shot (dispel type `enrage`). It is a `debuff` on the tank with `damageTakenMult` 1.4 (standing in for roughly 2.5x swings: the multiplier applies to everything on the tank, Shadow Flame included, so it is deliberately lower than 2.5). The `ranged` role carries the Tranq button (`roles.ranged.dispels: ['enrage']`) and is scored on it: expectation, press cue and `debuffSeconds` are all on `ranged`, and the healer no longer has a dispel at all. In the other seats nobody can press it, so the debuff's 4 s duration (not 10 s) stands for how fast the raid's hunters catch it. Fire Nova: `aoe` chained with `follow` after each Frenzy at +2 s and +4 s, 500 Fire (scaled from 555-645), and `conditional: debuff:frenzy` so a pulse only lands while Frenzy is up: a Tranq inside 2 s stops it completely, exactly as Wowhead describes (DPS take no damage when hunters react fast). Wing Buffet: `knockback` with `threatCut: 0.5`, first ~30 s then 30-35 s (cmangos), 1 s cast, as a single-tank model: the tank eats it and Taunts back. Shadow Flame: 2 s cast, 45 yd cone, first ~18 s then every 15-18 s (logs 12.9-23 s), 4000 Shadow, `conditional: onPlayer`. Thrash: cone on the tank every ~4 s. Summon Player is not modelled. Line of sight does not stop Fire Nova since patch 1.11, so it has no cover here. Damage is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike: melee 600 per 2 s, Thrash 500, Shadow Flame 4000, Wing Buffet 750, Fire Nova 500, Frenzy multiplies all tank damage by 1.4 while up; placeholders. Passive healing is 1400 HP/s on a player tank (the raid heals you and you cannot press your own heal), 1200 on the ghost without a healer player and 200 with one. Engine gaps: one tank role, so the buffet off-tank is the same player Taunting back; no hunter rotation or Tranq cooldown (the real 20 s cooldown with 2-3 hunters is represented by a free button); only the ranged seat can Tranq, so in the other seats Frenzy simply lasts its 4 s.

rangedSpot.label: Ranged: behind him, clear shot for Tranq

healerSpot.label: Healers: in reach of the tank

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him at the wall, back to it, head away from the raid, exactly as Ebonroc. When he frenzies the hunters shoot it off; you just survive it and Taunt back after every Wing Buffet.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Directly behind him, never in front. Fire Nova cannot be avoided by position, so wear your Fire Resistance and bandage if the Tranq rotation slips.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Behind him at range with a clear line for Tranq. You are the Tranq shot: the moment he frenzies, shoot it off. Inside 2 seconds the Fire Nova never comes. Keep your threat under a tank whose threat gets halved by Wing Buffet.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Hunters shoot Frenzy off; your job is the tank. Keep them up through the Thrash bursts, the Fire Nova pulses when a Frenzy gets through, and the Shadow Flames. Nothing here is yours to dispel.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment he turns on the raid, never while he is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Tranquilizing Shot
dispel.tip: Frenzy: +150% attack speed and Fire Nova every 2 s until a hunter Tranquilizing Shots it off. The Tranq order is named before the pull. In the ranged seat this button is the shot: land it inside 2 seconds and the Fire Nova never comes.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.tip: He frenzies every 10 to 15 seconds: attack speed up by 150% for 10 seconds and Fire Nova every 2 seconds on the raid. Hunters Tranquilizing Shot it off in a fixed order.

fireNova.label: Fire Nova
fireNova.tip: 555 Fire on the whole room every 2 seconds while he is frenzied, and not otherwise.

shadowFlame.label: Shadow Flame
shadowFlame.tip: A 2 s cast, 4 to 5 thousand Shadow in a 45 yd cone on the current tank. Everyone else stays behind him.

wingBuffet.label: Wing Buffet
wingBuffet.tip: A frontal shove and half your threat, every 30 to 35 seconds. Back to the wall and Taunt the moment he turns.

thrash.label: Thrash
thrash.tip: Three swings in quick succession on the tank. Under Frenzy this is the tank killer.

expectations.label: Pull him to the wall
expectations.tip: Taunt him, walk to the wall and turn him so his head is on it. Melee and ranged go behind him.

expectations.label: Taunt straight after the buffet
expectations.tip: Wing Buffet halves your threat and he turns. Taunt the moment you see it.

expectations.label: Keep your back to the wall
expectations.tip: If there is open floor behind you, Wing Buffet throws you and he moves.

expectations.label: His head stays on the wall
expectations.tip: Shadow Flame goes 45 yards in front of him. If it reaches the raid, people die.

expectations.label: Tranq Frenzy off the moment it lands
expectations.tip: Tranquilizing Shot the instant the emote and the size change fire. Every 2 seconds it stays up is another Fire Nova on the raid.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stop in the red band after a Wing Buffet
expectations.tip: The tank has just lost half their threat. If you were close before, you are over them now.

expectations.label: Stay out of Shadow Flame
expectations.tip: Everyone but the tank stays behind him.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Fire Nova on every Frenzy that slips through, and Shadow Flames on the current tank. Hunters Tranq; you heal.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in fire
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the fire before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds Frenzy stayed up
debuffSeconds.tip: Tranquilizing Shot the moment it lands. Every 2 seconds is another Fire Nova on the raid.

playerInFront.label: Standing in his front
playerInFront.tip: Melee stand directly behind him and never in front.

buffetsOffWall.label: Buffets taken off the wall
buffetsOffWall.tip: Back to the wall. In the open Wing Buffet throws you and he moves.

cues.notes: Press notes: Taunt straight after a Wing Buffet; Tranq the Frenzy the moment it lands; Heal behind each Shadow Flame.

list.label: Tranq the Frenzy
list.tip: Shoot the Frenzy off. Every 2 seconds of it is another Fire Nova on the raid.

list.label: Heal right after Shadow Flame
list.tip: Land the big heal the moment the breath lands.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a Frenzy up is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Wing Buffet and Frenzy
drills.description: Already against the wall. Wing Buffet every 12 s halves your threat: Taunt the moment he turns, then survive the Frenzy bursts.

drills.name: Behind him, keep attacking
drills.description: Attack on every global but stop in the red band. Every Wing Buffet halves the tank.

drills.name: Tranq the Frenzy
drills.description: Frenzy every 8 s: Tranq it off inside 2 s and the Fire Nova never lands.

drills.name: Healing through Frenzy
drills.description: Frenzy every 8 s and a Shadow Flame every 10 s: keep the tank up through the Thrash bursts and the Fire Nova pulses.

limitations: Tranquilizing Shot removes a substitute effect on the tank. Frenzy does not change the boss’s actual swing speed.
